title: Procedural No Default Fixture
description: Procedural sketch should not persist by default. Add selectable fixture; by default no fixture is selected. Persistence only via save/load tools.
summary: Fixed sketch persisting across refresh: FlowCanvas was auto-reading/writing shared localStorage key flow.fixture/v1. Procedural now passes createEphemeralFlowStore() so the canvas never persists to localStorage; only explicit Store/Load tools use procedural.fixture/v1. FlowCanvas also syncs external fixtureJson prop changes so fixture selection, reset, and restore still update the canvas.
